svg.text: Interfaces between subsystems (count; see N2 view)

Generated by tools/figures/models_readme.py from the .sysml files, tools/sysml/check.py and the records. The records are the source of truth; the model is checked against them. Passing a check is not a review.

g.text: Terms: ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · IF = interface (a count of interfaces in block diagrams, or an IF-nnn record) · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml)

· IF-PX4-nnn = PX4 integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source

flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers

· SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager

and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL

= pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis,
legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
